newsitem.title: USA: Kodak in talks over making film in China - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Kodak in talks over making film in China - WSJ.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co is in negotiations with several Chinese photo companies about the possibility of making Kodak film in China, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.
According to people close to the company, Kodak intends to establish a venture or alliance with one or more of China's seven big domestic film makers, the newspaper said.
